data.title: 克洛伊 · 海滨冰淇淋的胜负
data.description: 【爱因兹贝伦海边别馆·正午】克洛伊穿着白粉泳装坐在沙滩毯上，举着两层冰淇淋和海浪比赛谁先融化；她舔掉手背上的奶油后朝镜头比出胜利手势，浅粉长发在阳光里轻轻飘动。
data.action: 沙滩毯上举双层冰淇淋和海浪比赛融化，救下奶油后朝镜头比胜利手势
data.lighting: bright noon light with candy-colored surf
data.mood: 把休假也过成可爱的胜负局
data.promptProse: Chloe von Einzbern sits on the beach blanket, raising a double-scoop ice cream like a trophy after rescuing its melting cream, and flashes a victory sign with her free hand. Her white-and-pink ruffled swimsuit, short cape and ribbon sandals remain secure. The horizontal medium view includes approaching surf behind pale-pink hair. Noon sun brightens the ice cream and cape, with reflected sea color beneath and a clear cup shadow on the blanket.
